name: proof-of-presence
description: Proof of Presence: refundable event deposits (ETH or any ERC-20) where attendees share the no-shows' deposits, with the attendance list open to challenge in Kleros Court. Permissionless: any organiser creates an event from the factory.

scripts.test:web: node scripts/compile.mjs && node scripts/build-web.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/web.e2e.mjs
